defects.title: R5.R4/V6 modules unintegrated in production CLI callgraph
defects.resolution: Added opt-in `--job <json>` and `--creative-mode <legacy|director>` to `motionlab/cli.py` (`edit` & `plan`), wired end-to-end into `motionlab/composition/director_pipeline.py::run_multisource_director_job` and `motionlab/pipeline.py::_validate_multisource_director_run`.

defects.title: Single dark glass pill repeated at fixed y=1215..1255
defects.resolution: Built `motionlab/composition/scene_graph_v2.py` with 6 materially distinct visual silhouettes/polarities (open kinetic typography, warm-ivory calendar ribbon, 2-column split dilemma, smooth clip-path grid bridge, multi-row editorial board, minimal spatial CTA) + `calm_breathing_face` and dynamic `solve_dynamic_safe_layout(W, H, face_bounds, safe_zones)`.

defects.title: Hardcoded finance/Olivia defaults and silent CTA fallback on unknown kind
defects.resolution: Removed all hardcoded finance/Olivia strings from `motionlab/composition/calendar_editorial.py` and made unknown semantic kinds raise `ValueError` fail-closed in both `calendar_editorial.py` and `scene_graph_v2.py`.

defects.title: Hardcoded A/B source assumptions, fixed B room-tone window (9.25..9.75), and ±0.03s cut bleed
defects.resolution: Generalized `multi_source_timeline.py` and `speech_dedup.py` to arbitrary N sources, strict end-exclusive `[start_s, end_s)` mapping, VAD-proven quiet non-speech room-tone selection, and dynamic `detected_sources` watermark authorization.

defects.title: Real product demo absent; text benefits insufficient as product proof
defects.resolution: Engine now audits `AssetCatalog`, rejects `dir_C_product_led_demo` when authorized Notion/workbook assets are absent, labels conceptual visuals clearly as `ILLUSTRATIVE OVERVIEW`, enforces `build_claim_visual_coverage_matrix` (TEXT_ONLY/ILLUSTRATION never satisfy `ACTUAL_PRODUCT`), and flags `PRODUCT_PROOF_BLOCKED` + `CANDIDATE_9x16.mp4` naming.

defects.title: No multimodal VLM installed; single text LLM reasoning benchmark incomplete
defects.resolution: Provisioned Apache-2.0 `Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct Q4_K_M + mmproj Q8_0` (`models/manifest.json`), built `motionlab/semantic/model_router.py`, and executed 12-case comparative benchmark + real image perception + blurred refusal. Retained `Qwen2.5-3B` (12/12 raw) for text reasoning and adopted `Qwen3-VL-2B` for real multimodal perception & critic.

defects.title: Relaxed word preservation / ASR smoothing hiding stutters
defects.resolution: Director pipeline transcribes directly from 16kHz PCM with `condition_on_previous_text=False` (catching both 'what you can actually spend' and 'mental math' stutters + 'I know' filler + garbled tail/prefix) and executes strict independent Re-ASR on `edited_voice_bed.wav` enforcing 100% critical token recall, monotonic order, and 0 residual repeats.

defects.title: Temporal state rollback ($1200 -> $100 -> $1200) undetected
defects.resolution: Created generic domain-agnostic `motionlab/semantic/temporal_ledger.py` rejecting unmarked rollbacks, premature states, and weekday order inversions across all niches while allowing explicitly labeled recaps (`is_recap=True`).

defects.title: Fixed `balanced` bonus in pacing scorer and permissive rhythm critic
defects.resolution: Removed fixed `balanced` variant bonus in `motionlab/semantic/pacing_director.py` and hardened `motionlab/composition/visual_critic.py::run_rhythm_critic` to fail closed when cuts exist without verified voice bed / word preservation / join QA and return `WARN_REVIEW_REQUIRED` on medium findings.

defects.title: Abrupt cream title card jump between clip A and clip B
defects.resolution: Replaced static hard-cut cream card with animated `motivated_object_bridge` clip-path grid sweep in `scene_graph_v2.py` and verified decoded boundary MADs in `cut_continuity.json`.

defects.title: Missing manifest SHA linkage & blurred technical vs human/proof/rights gates
defects.resolution: Canonical runs emit `manifest.json`, `QA02_REPORT.json`, `TO_CHATGPT.txt`, and `watermark_auth.json` linking exact source/output/preview SHA-256s and explicitly separating technical pass from `BLOCKED_WATERMARK_AUTHORIZATION`, `PRODUCT_PROOF_BLOCKED`, `MISSING_SOURCE_DIALOGUE`, `LISTENING_NOT_RUN_AUTOMATED_PROXY_ONLY`, and `PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW`.

defects.title: Tests limited to synthetic dedup/HTML strings without callgraph, causal, negative, or VLM/repair proofs
defects.resolution: Added `test_r5r5_multisource_cli_and_temporal_ledger.py` and `test_r5r5_director_vlm_critic_and_repair.py` covering CLI callgraph, 3+ arbitrary sources, strict mapping, D03/D08/D09 negative mutations, prompt-injection/traversal guards, causal direction sensitivity, claim coverage truth guards, and real injected-defect critic+repair proof.
